book.title: Shilǝn ki Lya a toh ɗǝ Malkus

content: Cibǝlti tǝn mi'ka' gu ki inabi

Yesu pǝlisi shilǝn nǝ cibǝlti, i ulsisu, “Mullǝn ɗa mulnǝ pǝl gu inabi. I' gandǝli, i' ɗushu ki cetti mill inabi isi. I' kǝn yakǝn kǝs ki mul ɓutti gu. Ip bǝl mbalǝn yen mi' kwolu kǝ lǝbi. Ilǝge Atliwon.
Nǝgis cilu, i shin zheliwasi ma mi' kwolu i tǝ'kami' na mil inabi i te'ɗi.
Ngo nǝnǝgu mi'kwolluyi is gobti, is liti is katti tohwas koni.
I' shin zheli won' ɗanu ma'si; is li'muli aga, is lati ge'sha.
I' shin gon'ɗanu, tiɓo, is tloti. I shin gen ɗanu diɓǝli; genwasǝn gen'ɓo is tlosi, genwasǝn ge'si ɓo is li'si.
Hal nǝgunma Yakǝn, nǝm ɗiti. Gunǝ ti lyapti u. Ibpa' shi' yakǝni swamasi, i' usu, ‘nǝgon as yen naltwasi.’
Ngo nǝnǝgu mi'kollu i ma is ul elsǝsu ‘Yakuwas kǝngu, mulgu tiɗǝ nje' bwasi nganni, Mi tloti, alǝɓayi dǝmginǝn.’
Is gobti is tloti, is latitaka tyakalbi.
Yakǝn tǝ mulgu i pǝli? Tǝn mbǝti a tlwami' kwollu i si, ab bǝlmbalǝn yen gu isi.
Kiniɓo ka yanǝn shilǝn ki Lya ki laci gasonwaiya? Ki laci ɗa ɗǝ ussu, ‘Zǝnga u nǝ mi' kǝbbi nge u, i dǝm zǝnga gǝsbi ki ze'ki.
Gu kyautǝn ki Lya kǝni, ma'mini ulki gagashi'kǝni.’ ”
Bal lǝɓa, nǝ mi' bǝtl lashti zhil ki Musa ne' mi'kina is ngau shitu ki gobtiti, simani cimɓǝlti u tǝnsi ni, is kum ɓulti ki hwu mbalǝn. Gaki nǝgu is zati, is ziga wasǝn.
Ngepti tǝn Ɓǝtl up Ki ban ki Kaisal
Is shin palisiyawa yentey nǝ mbalǝn ki Hilidus, gaki si hwodǝl Yesu geshilǝ wasi.

Nǝs mbǝ u, is ultisu, “Mul, lashti mimani ki mul dlǝb balini, kiɗa olt mbalǝn wai, i' kan kowonngi ndatce, sai kullcit mbalǝn shitu ki Lya kǝnkiɗa. A ndalini ki tǝnɓalt upki banya, ki Kaisalya bal gu ki Loma, ko imi?
Tǝm ɓatliya kobǝn ɓatliwai?” Ti'ma nǝm mangashtwasǝn u nǝsikǝn ndǝtti u, I'ulsisu, “Yalaki i ki cimbǝltǝn ɗa? Nǝ kaminǝn ulpu te'ɗi tanǝyani.”
Is kamiktai. I ulsisu, “Shin ki wokǝni nǝ shishipti ki wokǝntǝnki? Is ultisu, ki Kaisalkǝni.”
I Yesu ulsisu, “Bǝlǝn Kaisal, ulnǝ ki Kaisal u, a'bǝlǝn Lya ulnǝ ki Lya u.” Is kum gagashinti ki Yesu.
Ngep tǝn Hillya Ki mi' Mǝshti
Sadukiyawa, si ussu, tlǝllya ki mi' mǝshtiɗawai, is mbǝ ma ti, nǝ gyemti,
“Mul lashti” is usu, “Musa alacimi, ǝn yelse ki mulǝn amǝcu, isza kǝliwasi bǝ yakǝn ni'ɗawai u, adǝmi hwel ki kan kǝlisi, azi yelse wagisi mil.
Is, pǝl mbalǝnyen elsǝni ini mwani gudǝl ninngi. Nǝm pǝl kutleti, immǝci taza yakǝnwai.
Kilopisi ma i kǝnkǝli i, tima immǝci, tambi Yakǝn sitwai. Ki maki ma nǝgu.
Nǝgu must ningi i sambi yakǝn ne'twai. Patibisi ikǝli i mǝci.
Gas, tlǝllya kǝmik mashti, kǝli kǝwo kǝntidǝmi age' si? Gaki muswasǝn sadǝm nǝkǝli isi i.”
I Yesu ulsisu, “Gaki nǝgu ki gǝlni ɗawaiwa? Gaki kimanǝn lwabatwai, bǝmanǝn pǝlti ki Lya wai.
Gas tlǝllya kǝmik mǝshti kuletti nǝn ɗawai, abǝkǝndǝti nǝn ɗawai, sitdǝm kǝnǝ milshinkǝn ki Lya kǝni.
Gaki tlǝl lya kimi mǝshti, kataɓa, dlap lashti ki lwabakki musa waiya, kǝnǝgunǝ Lya ultisu, ‘Ami ki Lya ki Iblahim, nǝ Ishaku nǝ Yakubu waiya?’
Gi'nǝ Lya wasǝn bǝ mul mushtiwai u, Lya wasǝn kamini. Balini kagǝlni i.”
Zhil mul Nalti
I mul bǝl lashti won ki Musa immbǝ immbisi ɗǝ shotti bi ne yelsǝni. Nǝ' en Yesu apǝlisi shilǝn ki zeki u in gyem Yesu, “Zhilu kǝnki mul natl kǝni?”
I Yesu ndǝgiti i ultisu “Mul nalti tikǝ, ‘Kumini mi' Islaila, Lya i nǝn, Lya nǝmkǝni.
Lyam Lya wagi nǝ mbadlwagi, nǝ dliwagi, nǝmanti wagi, nǝ ndǝl twagi.’
Mul bǝtlti iki, ‘ki Lyam yelsewagi kǝnǝ gawagi.’ Zho ulǝn nǝnɗa ti ngǝtl gu nǝnaltwai.”
I' mul lashti zhil ki Musa i ultisu, “A ndǝgi balini mul lashti, Lya nǝm kǝni, gonnǝn ɗawai saiti,
A' lyam Lya nǝ mus mbatlwagi, nǝ mus mantiwagi, nǝ mus ndǝltwagi, a' lyam yel'sewagi kǝnǝ gawagi, Ai ngǝtl ulnǝ ki kyeli Lya u nǝ poshti poshti u nǝ kini ɗa u lolu.”
Nǝ Yesu Ye'ni tapǝlli shilǝn ki zeki u, I ultisu, “Kiɗa lolu nǝ gu'ki Lya wai.” Pa'ti bisi mulǝn a ngemti nǝ ndǝl ki mbatl ki ullǝn nuwai.
Gyep tǝn Ya'kǝn ki Dauda
Nǝ Yesu ɗǝ, kulcik mbalǝn age libi ki Lya i' usu, “Yalaki i mi' lashti zhil ki Musa usu almasihu yakǝnkǝ Dauda ni?
Dauda gawasi, tǝn ndǝl ki yalki mbatl ki Lya ki gunti I usu,

content.text: he nǝ azǝkki a ga ɗǝ mik ngekki.” ’

content: Dauda gawasi immɓe' ki ‘Lya.’ Yala'ti atdǝm yakuwasɗa?” Hwu mbalǝn is ga'ki' kǝm nǝ holtugi.
Yesu Ɓuli mi' Lashti Zhil ki Musa Galɗǝga
A ge'lu kulcik mbalǝn ki Yesu, i' usu, “Pǝn ɗemɗem nǝmi bǝtl lashti zhil ki Musa, mi' lyap dunnǝ bas lulugǝl, lyamtiwasǝn tǝ mbalǝn gob shinnissi age'lu ulti nǝ ultitaka,
lyamtiwasǝn tǝ mbalǝn bǝtlsi ludǝp kizeki age'lu dopga ki Yahudawa, nǝlu daddabǝl.
Siki mi'ɗap lǝɓa ki mudliyi nǝ mwani mǝcisi u, nǝ pǝtl pyasi' shilǝn nǝ Lya gaki gǝl assan. Sisǝ' pocisi batlti mulndǝlti.”
Bǝtl up Ki kǝli u nǝ Mwani Mǝcitu
I Yesu dǝm malgun kǝlu kap up ki libi ki Lya, ati ya' ulpu nǝsi uttti agibɓi u. Hwu mbalǝn mik ulki toh asi utti ulpi milnalti.
Amma guli kǝliwonmbǝ gunǝ bǝ ullǝn nǝɗawai u gunǝ mwaniwas mǝci i bǝl bwasti dlom ki kobo, iki kobo nǝm,
I Yesu taki milkushtiwas bi, i ulsisu, “Balini, amipikkini, ulnǝ guli u utti u gunǝ bǝ ulǝn nǝɗa wai u ngǝl ki mbalǝn kap.
Musswasǝn si bǝlini tǝngaki usǝn wasǝn, ti ɓo jwa ulnǝ nǝtoh u tǝbǝli, gunǝ itidǝmiti.”
